name: Muse
subtitle: Font of Inspiration
description: Invoker that can gain power and spread it among her allies.
lore: The muses are the font of inspiration for poets, musicians, and artists throughout Olympus. In the old world, violence was alien to these lesser gods, but in Ryven even they must defend themselves. Muses prefer to spur others to fight for them, but when that proves insufficient, they have learned to raise arms, for even combat is its own form of art.
